signature.name: VTask.domLCongr
signature.type: (R : Type u_1) -> [Semiring R] -> {M : Type u_2} -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [Module R M] -> (N : Type u_3) -> [AddCommMonoid N] -> [Module R N] -> (ι : Type u_7) -> {M₂ : Type u_10} -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [Module R M₂] -> (S : Type u_12) -> [Semiring S] -> [Module S N] -> [SMulCommClass R S N] -> (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M₂) -> M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N ≃ₗ[S] M₂ [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N

conventions.statement: The forward map sends f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N to the alternating map obtained by precomposing with e.symm: fun x => f(e.symm ∘ x).
conventions.note: Precomposing with the inverse of e transports maps from domain M to domain M₂.

conventions.statement: The inverse map sends g : M₂ [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N to the alternating map obtained by precomposing with e: fun x => g(e ∘ x).
conventions.note: Precomposing with e itself transports maps from domain M₂ back to domain M.
